rules: First four picks: RB/WR (or elite TE) only. Allen/Lamar are the lone QB exception, and only if one slides to Round 3+.
6 of 8 make the playoffs — regular-season safety is overrated. Draft ceilings. Build a team that peaks in December.
Two FLEX spots + full PPR = you start 4-5 pass-catchers weekly. Hammer WR depth in rounds 4-8.
QB in rounds 6-9. The Tier-3 QBs (Caleb, Dak, Herbert) are basically free. Never roster 2 QBs before round 14, if at all.
TE: McBride/Bowers in Rd 2 is fine (positional cheat code). Otherwise wait for Loveland/Warren/Kraft, or punt to Fannin/Likely/Kincaid.
K and DEF in rounds 15-16. No exceptions. I will be watching, Briggsy.
Bench = 6 lottery tickets (Tuten, Price, Gainwell, Brooks, Blue, Lloyd types), not 'safe veterans.' The waiver wire IS your depth in an 8-teamer.
Two IR slots = free real estate. A falling Kittle/Charbonnet/Dell is profit you park.
The Miami Rule: no Dolphins pass-catchers. Achane only at a heavy discount — Malik Willis is the QB and the offense is rubble.
Trade deadline is Week 11 and pick-trading is ON. Hunter will attempt something. Send screenshots.

VBD amendment (Aug 5 war game): rounds 3-5, break same-tier ties toward RB over WR — mid-RB beats mid-WR over waiver replacement every year (the wire always has a 10-ppg WR on it, never a 13-ppg RB). Never reach across tiers for it; WR volume comes rounds 5-8. VORP = pts/season over waiver replacement (4-yr curves, our scoring; baselines QB12/RB41/WR47/TE12).

roundPlan.plan: Elite core: 2 of RB/WR studs (or 1 + McBride/Bowers). Ceiling over floor.
WR hammer + RB2. Grab a falling Allen/Lamar ONLY if it's robbery. Nabers/Waddle/Egbuka window.
QB (one), TE if you waited, best flex bodies. Burden/Tuten window opens.
Upside swings only: rookie RBs, breakout WRs, second TE if punting. No 'boring vet' picks.
Handcuffs & stashes: Herbert (SF), IR-slot arbitrage, camp risers.
DEF then K (or K then DEF). Take whoever's on the best offense/schedule — I'll call it live.

slotNotes.note: Gibbs/Bijan/Chase. Lock a Tier-1, come back at 14-16 for the best faller. Watch the Gibbs hold-in news.
Best of JSN/Nacua/JT/ASB. You'll get a second Tier-2 star on the way back — this is the value sweet spot.
The turn: two picks back-to-back. Pair a WR1 + RB1 (e.g., Jefferson + Cook), then you pick again at 24-25 — perfect for McBride/Bowers or an Allen/Lamar heist.

strategy.kickers: No kicker board needed in August. Final round: take the kicker attached to the best offense still available — early consensus says Cowboys, Chargers, Texans, Ravens, Bears kickers lead the pack. I'll hand you the exact name live on draft day.
